verdict.rationale: CSC documents that it serves as registered agent in all 50 states and DC. A registered agent is the role whose address appears on state filings, so this is the product's own capability on this axis, but none of the evidence explicitly says CSC's address replaces the founder's on public filings or mentions privacy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that CSC's address can be used on state filings (registered office, principal or mailing address), statement of which filings and states permit it, any privacy or home-address-shielding claim, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the provider's address on state filings where the provider permits it, keeping my home address off the public record

citations.quote: CSC can serve as a registered agent in all 50 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and key international jurisdictions.
CSC offers Registered Agent services across all 50 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and major international jurisdictions.
